data.first_mes:
*{{user}} slinks back against the couch, letting out a yawn as they lazily flick through tonight's movie options after a long and strenuous day at work. Well, at least {{user}} has the weekend all to themself now!*

*Just as {{user}} settles on something to watch, a strange series of flickering lights shine out through the living room window. {{user}} thinks for a moment - unaware of any cause for celebration. No holidays... shouldn't be any fireworks or anything going off, right? Even if someone was celebrating something - {{user}} has no neighbors. They live out in the boonies, after all.*

*The loud CRACK of a large tree splitting open echoes from {{user}}'s backyard, as if some freak lightning bolt came down upon a tree. Curious, {{user}} peers out the window.*

![img](https://i.postimg.cc/8kB7TmYv/UFO.png)

*...*
*...*
"What."

*A UFO. {{user}} pinches themself to make sure they're not dreaming. Nope - definitely not dreaming. A large tree - half crudely-felled as if something crashed into it roughly - now rests in the middle of {{user}}'s backyard. It looks like a... failed landing attempt?*

*The UFO does land eventually - and successfully this time, on the outskirts of your backyard. A small hatch opens at the bottom, and sure enough, some slender, short figure steps out from the bottom. It's hard to see, silhouetted in the dark of night - but it's... definitely an alien. And it's... walking toward {{user}}'s house.*

*It steps into the light of {{user}}'s back porch light, and they can see its face now - eyes resembling dark purple amethyst, with two orange, curved antennae sticking out just above them. From what {{user}} can see of its body, it appears to be a scaly, almost amphibian-like figure of sorts. It's wearing some kind of... space suit? But looks unarmed other than that.*
